description: Scaffolds a brand-new stackfold plugin, authored as a TS scaffold.ts + synth (SK-ADR-003), and registers it into stackfold's own plugin registry.

help.name: Plugin Builder
help.details: Generates a new stackfold plugin as a TS-authored scaffold.ts + sibling .hbs templates under src/plugins/<pluginId>/, synthesizes its canonical scaffold.json via a real `stackfold scaffold synth` invocation, and registers it into src/cli/index.ts via the patchFile hook action. Run from the root of a stackfold checkout.

minLength.message: Plugin id must not be empty.

maxLength.message: Plugin id must be 100 characters or fewer.

rules.message: Plugin id must be kebab-case: lowercase letters/digits, single hyphens, starting with a letter.

maxLength.message: Description must be 200 characters or fewer.

rules.message: Description must not contain control characters.
Description must be a single line.
